author: Forbes
description:
Highway Refinement Meets Trail Capability: Inside BFGoodrich’s Premium All-Terrain Strategy

When equipping high-end performance trucks, owners face a classic compromise: severe tire hum and sloppy steering on the highway in exchange for off-road capability. For over 50 years, BFGoodrich—a division of Michelin—has developed off-road tire technology. To test their latest generation of engineering, host Scotty Reiss joined Michelin Senior Subjective Test Driver Derek Secord at the Michelin Proving Ground to evaluate the BFGoodrich All-Terrain T/A KO3 on the Ford Bronco Raptor.

Selected as original equipment for flagship performance vehicles like the Ford Bronco Raptor and Ford F-150 Raptor, the third-generation KO3 was engineered specifically for drivers who demand seamless transitions between highway commuting and extreme trail riding.
